Definition: from G3844 and G191; to mishear, i.e. (by implication) to disobey:--neglect to hear.
BiblicalUsage: Parakouō means to mishear, to refuse to hear, to disobey. If a brother neglects to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican, and Jesus tells Jairus, Be not afraid, only believe — literally, hearing, do not fear.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hearing decides everything: the brother who will not hear the church is left outside, and the father who hears only believe sees his daughter live.
